all_findings.claim: As modelled, the cold plate thermally kills the inverter: source-to-inlet delta of 112.5 K nominal with an uncertainty band of 73.1–174.4 K. At any realistic FE coolant inlet (50–65 °C) the nominal case puts SiC junction at ~162–177 °C and the upper bound at ~224–239 °C, beyond any 175 °C-class module. Either the model is wrong or the hardware fails; both possibilities are disqualifying for reliance.

No coolant flow rate or inlet temperature is stated anywhere in the digest.
all_findings.fix: Obtain supplier module Rth datasheet, run cold-plate CFD, correlate on flow bench with stated flow rate and inlet temperature, redesign plate until worst-case Tj at max coolant inlet holds margin to module rating; keep analytical tagged UNVALIDATED until correlated.
